faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a boat rental in Marbella in 2034?
faq.a: The maximum group size depends on the boat's licensed capacity. Our largest vessels, like the Ferretti 94 (29m) and Canados 86 (26m), take up to 12 passengers. For groups larger than 12, you'll need to charter two boats. We can help coordinate that.

faq.q: Why are boat capacity limits so strict in Marbella?
faq.a: Capacity limits are set by Spanish maritime law and the boat's safety certificate. They are based on the vessel's design, life raft capacity, and stability calculations. Overloading is illegal, voids insurance, and can result in fines or port denial. We never exceed these limits.

faq.q: Can I bring extra guests if we don't tell the skipper?
faq.a: No. The skipper is legally responsible for the vessel and will enforce the maximum pax. Attempting to board more people than licensed is unsafe, illegal, and will result in the charter being cancelled. Always book a boat that matches your group size.

faq.q: Which boats in your fleet can take 12 passengers?
faq.a: Several boats in our fleet are licensed for 12 passengers: Mangusta 80 (24m), Mangusta 80 Grey (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), K80 (24m), and Maiora 26m (26m). All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What if my group has more than 12 people?
faq.a: For groups larger than 12, we recommend chartering two boats. For example, you could book a Mangusta 80 (12 pax) and an Astondoa 40 (9 pax) to accommodate up to 21 guests. Contact us via WhatsApp to plan a multi-boat charter.

faq.q: Are children counted in the passenger limit?
faq.a: Yes, children of any age count toward the maximum pax. Spanish maritime regulations do not exempt infants or toddlers. If you have a group of 10 adults and 2 children, you need a boat licensed for 12 pax.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat for just 2 people?
faq.a: Absolutely. We have smaller vessels like the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) that are perfect for couples or small groups. You'll have plenty of space and a private skipper.

faq.q: How do I book a boat for a specific group size?
faq.a: Browse our fleet page to see each boat's max pax. Once you know your group size, use the WhatsApp button on the boat's detail page to check availability and get a price. We'll confirm the booking and send you a link to pay a deposit.

data.body_html:
Planning a group charter in Marbella for 2034? The first number you need to know is not the price — it's the maximum pax. Every boat in our fleet has a licensed capacity that you cannot exceed, no exceptions. This guide explains the marbella boat rental group size limits 2034, the legal reasons behind them, and exactly which boat fits your party. Whether you're a couple or a crowd of 12, we have the vessel — and the rules — to keep your day safe and legal.

Why Group Size Limits Exist

Boat capacity limits are not suggestions. They are set by the Spanish Maritime Authority based on each vessel's stability calculations, life raft capacity, and safety equipment. Overloading a boat is dangerous — it affects handling, increases the risk of capsizing, and leaves no room for emergency gear. In Marbella, port police and the Guardia Civil can (and do) check passenger counts at the dock. If your group exceeds the limit, the charter will be cancelled and you will not receive a refund. We never risk it.

Here are the exact passenger limits for every boat in our fleet, all departing from Puerto Banús. Choose the one that matches your group size.

What If Your Group Is Larger Than 12?

If you have more than 12 people, you cannot all fit on one boat — but you can charter two. For example, combine a Mangusta 80 (12 pax) with an Astondoa 40 (9 pax) to accommodate up to 21 guests. Both boats can cruise together, anchor at the same coves, and return to Puerto Banús. We can arrange this for you. Just contact us via WhatsApp with your group size and preferred date.

Children Count Too

Yes, every passenger counts — infants, toddlers, and adults alike. Spanish maritime regulations do not exempt children from the maximum pax. A group of 10 adults and 2 babies still requires a boat licensed for 12. Plan accordingly.

What's Included in Every Charter

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees. You just show up at Puerto Banús with your group (within the limit) and enjoy the day.

How to Book for Your Group Size

First, decide how many guests you have. Then pick a boat from the table above that matches or exceeds that number. For boats with prices listed (Tier A and Tier B), you can book directly via our website. For all others, use the WhatsApp button on the boat's detail page to check availability and get a price. We'll send you a link to pay a deposit and confirm the charter.
